title: ChugStabilizer — detection model, dynamic reduction, Preserve Pick
description:
Implement Chug Stabilizer DSP: palm-mute detection score, dynamic wide-bell/low-shelf reduction, and Preserve Pick detail preservation per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §7.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §7.1–7.5 and §21.5 (detection model, controls, fixtures intent)
- Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.h/.cpp (ballistics — read only; reuse if appropriate)
- Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.h/.cpp and BiquadCoefficients patterns (read only)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h chug_* IDs if present (read only)

Implement Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.h and Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.cpp:
1. ChugStabilizer with prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize), reset(), process on audio buffers — no heap in process; not a gate (never silence between notes).
2. Detection: maintain L_low (target low-band detector ~70–300 Hz configurable) and L_mid (broad mid reference). Compute score:
   C[n] = w1*max(0, L_low - T_low) + w2*max(0, dL_low/dt - T_d) + w3*max(0, L_low - L_mid - Delta)
   Configurable weights via transient sensitivity / low-mid dominance sensitivity; automatic or manual threshold.
3. Reduction: map score through attack 0.2–20 ms, hold 0–80 ms, release 15–350 ms into gain reduction up to maximum reduction 0–18 dB applied via wide dynamic bell or low shelf at target frequency 60–320 Hz with bandwidth 0.3–2.5 octaves. Optional static support gain (small fixed cut/boost under the dynamic curve).
4. Preserve Pick: parallel high-frequency / broadband transient detector; when broadband transient is strong but low-band dominance is normal, reduce applied GR so pick attacks are not treated as chug overload.
5. Controls setters for enable, target frequency, bandwidth, max reduction, threshold (auto/manual), attack/hold/release, preservePick, transientSens, dominanceSens, static support, listen modes (audition reduction/removed contribution where feasible without owning GUI).
6. Visualization/data getters: detected event flag, L_low, current GR curve params, reduction history sample or last GR dB, trigger source enum (raw energy / dominance / transient acceleration) for §7.5.
7. Reuse EnvelopeFollower or local envelopes; band detectors may be simple bandpass/lowpass filters from existing coefficient helpers.

Do NOT edit PluginProcessor, CMakeLists.txt, TightCut, or tests.
acceptance_criteria: Detection implements C[n] from L_low, dL_low/dt, and L_low-L_mid dominance terms per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md section 7.2
Dynamic reduction uses attack/hold/release ballistics capped by max reduction 0–18 dB on a wide bell or low shelf at 60–320 Hz
Preserve Pick reduces false GR when broadband transient is strong without low-band dominance
Module does not gate/silence between notes when input falls below chug detectors
Exposes visualization fields for event, low-band energy, current reduction, and trigger source
No heap allocation in process paths
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.* or Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.* beyond include/use

allowed: reuse EnvelopeFollower ballistics for L_low/L_mid and GR smoother
RBJ bell or low-shelf for reduction filter
enum trigger source and POD visualization struct
